verdict.rationale: Linear's first-party Loops feature lets users describe a job in plain language and choose to run it on a schedule or in response to an event. That is a product-native recurring agent workflow, not a one-off action. The evidence is changelog-level only and does not show how schedules are configured or what cadences are available. Missing for 10: documented schedule configuration details (frequency/cadence options, time zones, run history or management), independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled loops.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Loops are a new way for Linear Agent to take on recurring work for your team. Describe the job in plain language and then choose whether it should run on a schedule or in response to an event.
Loops are recurring agent workflows for teams.
use Loops to keep docs and project descriptions up-to-date
